logp.method_description: Oil/water partition coefficients (logPO/W) were measured at ambient temperature. The examined complexes (40 μM) dissolved in 1 mL water were mixed with 1 mL n-octanol and sonicated for 30 min before being centrifuged at 4000 rpm for 10 min. The two phases could then be separated and measured on a UV-Vis spectrophotometer to determine the concentrations of complexes. The oil/water partition coefficients were calculated using the equation: logPo/w = logCo/Cw, where Co is the concentration of the complex in octanol and Cw is the concentration of the complex in the water phase. Each measurement was repeated 3 times.
